fnol_text: My name is Arjun Sorensen and I live at 413 Foxglove Terrace, Madison, WI 53762. You can reach me on (555) 980-3033 or arjun.sorensen@example.com. We had a cloudburst on 27 September 2025. The drains in the street could not cope and surface water from the road came up the drive and into the ground floor through the front door. Policy HH-2023-00072. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Sorensen on (555) 980-3033 to acknowledge the claim. Arjun confirmed the loss date as 27 September 2025.
Site visit to 413 Foxglove Terrace. Neighbour Kofi Ishikawa was present and confirmed the timeline.
Arjun sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
